description: R-SQL-1 SQL-UNION-02, SQL-REL: What common output Field type/size/precision and value types does UNION give for Currency/Decimal (both orders), Long/Text, Date/Double, Text(20)/Text(60), Text/Memo under UNION and UNION ALL, and a Null literal arm before and after a Currency arm? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-mdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.

args.text: SELECT c AS v FROM N UNION SELECT x FROM ND
SELECT x AS v FROM ND UNION SELECT c FROM N
SELECT l AS v FROM N UNION SELECT t FROM N
SELECT dt AS v FROM N UNION SELECT d FROM N
SELECT name AS v FROM L UNION SELECT t FROM S
SELECT t AS v FROM S UNION SELECT m FROM S
SELECT t AS v FROM S UNION ALL SELECT m FROM S
SELECT Null AS v FROM L UNION SELECT c FROM N
SELECT c AS v FROM N UNION SELECT Null FROM L
